#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""CrossCheck replayable telemetry validator.

Reads one UTF-8 JSON request document from stdin until EOF, writes exactly one
JSON result document to stdout and exits zero.  Unacceptable documents answer
``{"error":"invalid_json"}``.
"""
import sys

from crosscheck.engine import run_request
from crosscheck.wire import InvalidJSON, dump_result, load_request

INVALID_JSON = '{"error":"invalid_json"}'


def main():
    data = sys.stdin.buffer.read()
    try:
        request = load_request(data)
    except (InvalidJSON, ValueError, UnicodeError):
        sys.stdout.write(INVALID_JSON + '\n')
        sys.stdout.flush()
        return 0
    try:
        result = run_request(request)
    except Exception as exc:  # outside the documented domain
        sys.stderr.write('crosscheck: out-of-domain request: %r\n' % (exc,))
        sys.stdout.write(INVALID_JSON + '\n')
        sys.stdout.flush()
        return 0
    sys.stdout.write(dump_result(result) + '\n')
    sys.stdout.flush()
    return 0


if __name__ == '__main__':
    sys.exit(main())
EOF
